title: How a Man of God Trains the Guy Who Might Replace Him
caption:
There's a new guy at work. He's sharp. And part of you wants to keep him a step behind.

Most men protect their spot by holding back what they know. A man of God does the opposite. He teaches the guy everything, lets him take the credit, corrects him in private, and prays for him by name.

That isn't weakness. It's a man who knows his future is in God's hands, not his boss's.

"I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth." 1 Corinthians 3:6

Save this for your next first day as the experienced guy. Send it to the man who trained you.
